mapper.insert: insert into `leave`(employee_id, leave_type, start_date, end_date, reason, status, apply_time, approve_time) values (#{employeeId}, #{leaveType}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{applyTime}, #{approveTime})
mapper.select: select id, employee_id, leave_type, start_date, end_date, reason, status, apply_time, approve_time from `leave` order by apply_time desc limit #{offset}, #{size}
select id, employee_id, leave_type, start_date, end_date, reason, status, apply_time, approve_time from `leave` where employee_id = #{employeeId} order by apply_time desc
